newsitem.title: USA: Bomb rocks abortion clinic in Oklahoma.
newsitem.headline: Bomb rocks abortion clinic in Oklahoma.

text.p: A bomb explosion rocked an abortion clinic on Sunday, just three days after six people were injured in an attack on an Atlanta clinic.

Police spokesman Kevin Satkus said a bomb went off outside the Reproductive Services of Tulsa clinic shortly after 3 p.m. CST (2100 GMT), but no one was injured because the clinic was closed for the day.
"There were no injuries and only minimal damages to the building," Satkus said.

He said bomb experts from the Federal Bureau of Investigation and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms were already investigating the bombing but were moving cautiously because of fears of a booby trap. "We are concerned about secondary devices so they are being careful."
On Thursday two bombs ripped through an abortion clinic in Atlanta. The second about one came one hour after the first and injured six people.
Satkus said it was the second time the Tulsa clinic has been attacked this year. On New Year's Day assailants lobbed two molotov cocktails at the building and caused damage but no injuries.
